(Currently Amended) 2) Composition according to Claim 1 wherein the compound of formula I is 5-(7-methoxy-3,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1-indole-5-yl)-3-methyl-penta-2,4-dienoic and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof.

(Currently Amended) 3) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1 or 2, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action for the treatment of skin diseases.

(Currently Amended) 4) Composition according to one or more of the Claim 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight.

(Currently Amended) 6) Composition according to claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine, preferably in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight, more preferably 0.1 to 5 per cent by weight and especially 0.1 to 2 per cent by weight.

(Currently Amended) 7) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition for the treatment of skin diseases.

(Currently Amended) 8) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for treating skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation.

(Currently Amended) 9) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care and/or hair follicle development.

(Currently Amended) 10) Use the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the care, preservation or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair, including reduction of skin imperfections.

(Currently Amended) 11) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 as a skin care active agent.

(Currently Amended) 12) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 or 2 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening.

(Currently Amended) 13) Use the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against or reduction of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles and fine lines.

(Currently Amended) 14) Use the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against time- and/or light-induced aging processes of the human skin or human hair, particularly against dry skin and wrinkle formation.
